# JuliaCon 2026 

## Talks

### Can Attend

#### StructuralEquationModels.jl

*Wed 12:00 · Muschel — N2 · Maximilian Ernst & Aaron Peiket.* Julia implementation of structural equation models (SEMs) — efficient for large variable networks (e.g. genetics) and parallel fitting (e.g. neuroimaging), and extensible via custom loss functions and optimization backends. Relevant to my econometrics background.

#### JuliaDecisionFocusedLearning.jl

*Thu 14:30 · Alte Mensa — Atrium Maximum · Léo Baty.* Practical intro to the JuliaDecisionFocusedLearning ecosystem (Benchmarks + Algorithms packages) — a high-level, generic interface to state-of-the-art decision-focused learning (DFL) methods; relevant to quant/optimization workflows.

**Notes**:

- Parallels to reinforcement learning (trying to learn policies)
- Inputs -> Prediction -> Combinatorial Optimization (CO) -> Decision -> Loss
- In general, not easy to backpropagate through CO (piece-wise constant)

#### DynamicalSystems.jl

*Thu 14:30 · Tent — RW1 · George Datseris.* State-of-the-library review of DynamicalSystems.jl in 2026, centred on ComplexityMeasures.jl and Attractors.jl, plus recent additions (CriticalTransitions.jl, TransitionsInTimeseries.jl, RecurrenceMicrostatesAnalysis.jl) and roadmap.

### Cannot Attend

#### Agentif.jl

*Wed 10:30 · Muschel — N2 · Jacob Quinn.* Agent primitives for building LLM/agent apps in pure Julia: LLMProviders.jl (unifies Anthropic/OpenAI/OpenRouter), the core agent loop (Agent/Tool/Channel/Session/Compaction/middleware), LLMTools.jl (subagents, pty sessions, web search, Julia workers, bash), and Vo.jl example assistant.

#### Cross-Country Macroeconomic Forecasting

*Wed 14:45 · Alte Mensa — Atrium Maximum · Vrishank Sai Anand.* Uses PINNs and Universal Differential Equations to model macro debt cycles, comparing India, Sri Lanka and Argentina under sparse annual data.

#### LLMs, agents and tools

*Fri 16:45 · Alte Mensa — Atrium Maximum · Anshul Singhvi.* State-of-the-art overview of using AI agents with Julia: which agents to use, MCP servers, and skills — aimed at beginners.

## Speakers

### Andreas Noack

VP Product Development at PumasAI. PhD in economics (U. Copenhagen) with an econometrics + CS background; numerical linear algebra and parallel computing; leads the Pumas pharmacometrics product. Strong overlap with my economics → Julia → industry path. Talk: *Staged programming in pharmacometrics*.

### Vrishank Sai Anand

Gave the *Cross-Country Macroeconomic Forecasting* talk; research sits at the intersection of SciML, AI and quantitative finance — closest macro-finance ML speaker at the conference.
